_peak: THIS EPISODE IS CUT AT --peak -1.2, NOT THE DEFAULT -3.
split.mjs lifts the loudest point of the whole TAKE to the peak it is given.
On DJI_42 that point is not inside any line the film uses, so at the default
the finished voice track came out at -29.5 dBFS mean and -4.8 peak, about
1.8 dB under the other three films. The lightbox plays all four without
changing level between them, so that drop is audible when a viewer watches
-1.2 puts the film itself at -27.7 mean and -3.0 peak, which is Treasury's
number exactly. Re-cut this episode WITH THE FLAG or the levels revert and
nothing says so: the cuts come out identical either way, so the usual
re-split report stays silent about it.
Set 2026-11-02. The gain is the only thing it changes; every cut point was
compared against vo/_source.json before and after and not one moved.
